statusLine.command: input=$(cat); model=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.model.display_name'); used=$(echo "$input" | jq -r '.context_window.used_percentage // empty'); if [ -n "$used" ]; then pct=$(printf '%.0f' "$used"); [ "$pct" -lt 0 ] 2>/dev/null && pct=0; [ "$pct" -gt 100 ] 2>/dev/null && pct=100; filled=$(( pct / 5 )); empty=$(( 20 - filled )); bar=$(printf '%*s' "$filled" '' | tr ' ' '█')$(printf '%*s' "$empty" '' | tr ' ' '░'); printf "%s | [%s] %d%%" "$model" "$bar" "$pct"; else printf "%s" "$model"; fi
